title: Daily reward
one_line: Seven day cards, today lit and bouncing, day seven a chest.
opens_from: app launch (once per day, if eligible)

anatomy.spec: 7 small cards (bible 5.4 small card variant) in a row or two rows of 4/3, one per day: claimed = ticked, today = lit and bouncing (bible 2.9 idle rule - the only idle element here), future = dimmed, day 7 = a chest render instead of a coin/item icon.

states: Already claimed today - screen does not show at all, or shows a 'come back tomorrow' variant if reached manually
Streak broken - day 1 restarts, shown honestly, no guilt copy
motion: Today's card bounces continuously - the only idle element (bible 2.9).
Claim: count-up plus a small burst on the claimed card.
tokens.json motion.countUp for the reward number.
data: A streak counter and last-claimed date, server-owned once T-A3 ships so it cannot be reset by reinstalling.

assets_needed.name: logo_dailyreward
assets_needed.prompt: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 6, P1-3: DAILY REWARD logotype, same style as VICTORY!.

do_not: Do not let more than one card breathe/bounce at once.
Do not let the streak be resettable by reinstalling once the server owns it.
Do not guilt-trip a broken streak in the copy.
acceptance: Claiming updates the streak server-side once wired.
steps: 2. Build the 7-card layout with per-day states.
3. Wire CLAIM with the count-up and burst.
4. Wire the streak to a server-owned counter (or a clearly local placeholder until T-A3).
prompt:
Build the Ludo NX Daily Reward takeover.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md section 6.12, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

This does not exist yet. Build: the DAILY REWARD logotype, seven small cards in a row (one per day - claimed ticked, today lit and gently bouncing, future days dimmed, day 7 shown as a chest render), and CLAIM in a collar on the bottom edge.

Only today's card animates - it is the one idle element allowed on the screen. The streak counter should be server-owned once T-A3 ships so it survives a reinstall; until then, mark it clearly as a local placeholder.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
